lean.statement:
∀ {E : Type u_1}
  [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [inst_2 : CompleteSpace E] {f : E → ℝ} {X Y : ℝ → E}
  {α T : ℝ},
  0 ≤ α →
    0 ≤ T →
      Differentiable ℝ f →
        StrongConvexOn Set.univ α f →
          ContinuousOn X (Set.Icc 0 T) →
            ContinuousOn Y (Set.Icc 0 T) →
              (∀ t ∈ Set.Ico 0 T, HasDerivWithinAt X (-gradient f (X t)) (Set.Ici t) t) →
                (∀ t ∈ Set.Ico 0 T, HasDerivWithinAt Y (-gradient f (Y t)) (Set.Ici t) t) →
                  ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc 0 T, ‖Y t - X t‖ ≤ Real.exp (-α * t) * ‖Y 0 - X 0‖
approved_definition_context: Differentiable R f means Frechet differentiable at every point. gradient f x is the Riesz representing vector of that derivative in the specified complete real inner-product space.
StrongConvexOn Set.univ a f means f((1-lambda)*x+lambda*y)<= (1-lambda)*f(x)+lambda*f(y)-(a/2)*lambda*(1-lambda)*norm(y-x)^2 for all x,y and lambda in [0,1].

Set.Icc a b is [a,b]; Set.Ico a b is [a,b); Set.Ici t is [t,infinity). HasDerivWithinAt X v (Set.Ici t) t is the right derivative of X at t equal to v. ContinuousOn is continuity relative to the specified closed interval, including endpoints.
